source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entry 506 changes several list/dialog overflow-y values from scroll to auto. Current tree and OpenPGP import list retain auto. The commit calls for testing OS always-visible scrollbars and overlay scrollbars, with both empty and truly overflowing content. This prevents an unconditional empty scrollbar without removing scrolling when needed. The manual test matrix was read, not executed.
title: Use automatic scrolling when a container can be empty
